blocks.context: A seed can remain dormant until conditions become favorable for growth.

segments.label: (A)
segments.text: Once moisture reaches the seed, its outer coat softens and the embryo begins to develop.

segments.label: (B)
segments.text: The young root grows downward, anchoring the plant and absorbing water from the soil.

segments.label: (C)
segments.text: A shoot then grows toward the light, allowing the first leaves to begin photosynthesis.
